posts.title: my father died
posts.description: i have insane dreams, and i love them. i also love telling people about them, in great detail, which most people hate. and my father really hated it. every time i said "i had this crazy dream last night" he would roll his eyes and say "oh no, here we go...". so in his honour, i will not tell my whole dream from the other night, only the part that matters: my father was alive, but he never appeared

posts.title: I never want to work
posts.description: As a self-employed person, I am the best employer I've ever had, and also the worst employee that's ever lived. I literally never want to work, and more often than not I just don't. I'm pretty sure that, in the long run, it’s not sustainable.
